info.description: Local API for Qdrant Multitenant RAG Tiering: per-tenant RAG served from a Qdrant hot tier, with idle tenants parked as verified snapshots in Backblaze B2 and restored on their next query. This contract documents the sample's local API, not a hosted public endpoint.
info.title: Qdrant Multitenant RAG Tiering API

schema.title: Response List Files Endpoint Files Get

get.description:
Stream an object's bytes through the API.

Replaces presigned GET URLs: the bytes are read with the backend's S3
client (custom user agent) and never fetched by the browser from B2.

Checksums recomputed on demand.

Unlike /metadata (a cheap head_object), this downloads the object, so it is
billed at the tighter 'write' rate-limit tier (see runtime/ratelimit.py) to
bound egress/cost amplification.
get.summary: Get File Detail By Key Endpoint
